Explanation of the change:

1. We remove the old line  
     `local lang = codeBlockEl.attr.classes[1]`  
   which only ever saw “cell-code” or “language-…” instead of the actual language id.
2. We loop through **all** of `codeBlockEl.attr.classes`, strip any leading `language-` prefix, and then test against your `kLangCommentChars`.  
3. Once we have a matching key (e.g. `vhdl` or `cpp`), we pass that to `annoteProvider(lang)` so the correct comment markers (`"--"` or `"//"`) are used when matching and stripping ‘<1>’, ‘<2>’, etc.

This will re-enable annotation detection and replacement for both VHDL and C/C++ code blocks.
